batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2023-2024, Set-R — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank, 2015-2025), book PDF pp.22-25 (questions; printed answer table on p.25; printed worked solutions pp.25-28). EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys, and no independent second source for Set-R has been located yet. Sole exception: Q12 and Q62 carry answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' with an empty key and answer status 'verified' (a validator requirement for that disposition); that status records ONLY the primary source's own explicit printed claim — the book's printed worked solutions state '(সঠিক উত্তর নেই)' (no correct answer) and the printed answer table shows a dash for both — it is not independent verification. NOTE: the sha256 recorded for the source document is the hash computed from the archived PDF file itself (f8548d34...); it differs from the malformed 65-character value circulated in the task brief. Source anomalies preserved as printed: Q17 stem prints 'îy + k̂z' (the book's own solution notes ĵ was intended); Q61 options (a) and (b) are both printed '-2'; Q78's stem repeats the clause 'সমীকরণের মূলদ্বয় জটিল হলে' twice; Q29 and Q36 are ICT-topic items printed inside the Physics block (Q15-36) and keep Physics as subject per the printed layout; Q23 depends on a printed circuit diagram. Subject split: Bangla Q1-3, English Q4-6, ICT Q7-14, Physics Q15-36, Chemistry Q37-58, Higher Mathematics Q59-80. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]
